```{r setup}
library(MATH4753FALLKistler)
```

## CLT for Poisson
The mycltp function simulates the Central Limit Theorem by taking random samples from a Poisson distribution and plotting the distribution of the sample means.The function takes the following arguments:

n: The sample size per iteration.

iter: The number of iterations(simulations).

lambda: The Poisson rate parameter ($\lambda$).

## Example
```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}
# Run the simulation with n=10, 10000 iterations, and lambda=4
mycltp(n = 10, iter = 10000, lambda = 4)
```
